title: Pollen balances get a clearer split
summary:
Pollen balances became easier to read, publishable-key limits began tracking usage costs, and the legacy text API stopped adding referral links by default.

Enter now shows tier and pack Pollen separately alongside their combined balance and a daily allowance indicator. Generation requests draw from tier Pollen first, then pack Pollen; a follow-up updated the frontend meter configuration.

The legacy text API no longer inserts referral links by default. The explicit p-ads test marker remains available.

Publishable API keys moved from a three-request bucket to a Pollen-based limit per key and IP. The limiter charges the request's actual Pollen cost and reports retry timing in rate-limit headers; secret keys bypass it.
